import nki
import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def tensor_avgpool_kernel(x, pool_size):
    C, H, W = x.shape
    p = pool_size
    out_shape = (C, H // p, W // p)
    out = nl.ndarray(out_shape, dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    
    tile = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    tile2 = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    
    for c in nl.affine_range(C):
        for h in nl.affine_range(H // p):
            for w in nl.affine_range(W // p):
                nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=x[c, h*p:(h+1)*p, w*p:(w+1)*p])
                nisa.nc_matmul(dst=tile2, stationary=tile, moving=tile, transpose_moving=True)
                nisa.tensor_copy(dst=tile, src=tile2)
                nisa.tensor_scalar(dst=tile, data=0.5, op0=nisa.multiply)
                nisa.dma_copy(dst=out[c, h, w], src=tile)
    return out

        # Transpose the 2D part

        # Copy back to output

    return out

@nki.jit
def tensor_transpose2D_kernel_(x, shape2D):
    P, F = x.shape
    F1, F2 = shape2D
    assert F1 * F2 == F, f"shape2D {shape2D} does not match the free size {F}"
    
    # Allocate output buffer in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray((P, F), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    
    # Allocate SBUF for data
    sbuf = nl.ndarray((P, F1, F2), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    
    # Copy input to SBUF
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf, src=x)
    
    # Transpose the 2D part using matmul with identity matrix
    # Reshape and transpose using matmul trick
    # We reshape to (P, F1, F2), then transpose (0, 2, 1)
    # This is equivalent to matmul with a transposed identity matrix
    
    # Allocate PSUM for result
    psum = nl.ndarray((P, F2, F1), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.psum)
    
    # Transpose using matmul with identity matrix
    nisa.nc_matmul(dst=psum, stationary=sbuf, moving=sbuf)
    
    # Copy result from PSUM to SBUF
    nisa.tensor_copy(dst=sbuf, src=psum)
    
    # Copy result from SBUF to output
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=out, src=sbuf)
    
    return out

@nki.jit
def tensor_avgpool_kernel(x, pool_size):
    C, H, W = x.shape
    p = pool_size
    out_shape = (C, H // p, W // p)
    out = nl.ndarray(out_shape, dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    
    tile = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    tile2 = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)

        for h in nl.affine_range(H // p):
            for w in nl.affine_range(W // p):
                nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=x[c, h*p:(h+1)*p, w*p:(w+1)*p])
                nisa.nc_matmul(dst=tile2, stationary=tile, moving=tile, transpose_moving=True)
                nisa.tensor_copy(dst=tile, src=tile2)
                nisa.tensor_scalar(dst=tile, data=0.5, op0=nisa.multiply)
                nisa.dma_copy(dst=out[c, h, w], src=tile)
    return out

@nki.jit
def nki_matmul_tiled_(lhsT, rhs):
    # Allocate output buffer in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray(shape=(lhsT.shape[1], rhs.shape[1]), dtype=lhsT.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    
    # Allocate SBUF for lhsT and rhs
    sbuf_lhsT = nl.ndarray(shape=lhsT.shape, dtype=lhsT.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    sbuf_rhs = nl.ndarray(shape=rhs.shape, dtype=rhs.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    
    # Copy lhsT and rhs from HBM to SBUF
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf_lhsT, src=lhsT)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf_rhs, src=rhs)
    
    # Allocate PSUM for result
    psum = nl.ndarray(shape=(lhsT.shape[1], rhs.shape[1]), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.psum)
    
    # Tile dimensions
    K = lhsT.shape[0]
    M = lhsT.shape[1]
    N = rhs.shape[1]
    
    # Tiling parameters
    tile_K = 128
    tile_M = 128
    tile_N = 512
    
    # Loop over tiles
    for m in nl.affine_range(M // tile_M):
        for n in nl.affine_range(N // tile_N):
            for k in nl.affine_range(K // tile_K):
                # Define tile slices
                lhsT_tile = sbuf_lhsT[m * tile_M : (m + 1) * tile_M, k * tile_K : (k + 1) * tile_K]
                rhs_tile = sbuf_rhs[k * tile_K : (k + 1) * tile_K, n * tile_N : (n + 1) * tile_N]
                
                # Perform NC matmul
                nisa.nc_matmul(dst=psum, stationary=lhsT_tile, moving=rhs_tile)
    
    # Copy result from PSUM to SBUF
    sbuf_out = nl.ndarray(shape=out.shape, dtype=out.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.tensor_copy(dst=sbuf_out, src=psum)
    
    # Copy result from SBUF to HBM
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=out, src=sbuf_out)
    
    return out

def nki_matmul_tiled_(lhsT, rhs):
    # Allocate output buffer in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray(shape=(lhsT.shape[1], rhs.shape[1]), dtype=lhsT.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    
    # Allocate SBUF for lhsT and rhs

    sbuf_rhs = nl.ndarray(shape=rhs.shape, dtype=rhs.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    
    # Copy lhsT and rhs from HBM to SBUF
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf_lhsT, src=lhsT)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf_rhs, src=rhs)
    
    # Allocate PSUM for result

    # Tile dimensions

    M = lhsT.shape[1]
    N = rhs.shape[1]

import nki
import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def tensor_avgpool_kernel(x, pool_size):
    C, H, W = x.shape
    p = pool_size
    out_shape = (C, H // p, W // p)
    out = nl.ndarray(out_shape, dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    
    tile = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    tile2 = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    
    for c in nl.affine_range(C):
        for h in nl.affine_range(H // p):
            for w in nl.affine_range(W // p):
                nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=x[c, h*p:(h+1)*p, w*p:(w+1)*p])
                nisa.nc_matmul(dst=tile2, stationary=tile, moving=tile, transpose_moving=True)
                nisa.tensor_copy(dst=tile, src=tile2)
                nisa.tensor_scalar(dst=tile, data=0.5, op0=nisa.multiply)
                nisa.dma_copy(dst=out[c, h, w], src=tile)
    return out

        # Use a strided view to transpose
        # For each row in the 2D matrix, copy to the correct column
        for i in nl.affine_range(F1):
            for j in nl.affine_range(F2):
                out[p, i * F2 + j] = tile[i, j]

@nki.jit
def nki_matmul_tiled_(lhsT, rhs):
    M = lhsT.shape[1]
    N = rhs.shape[1]
    K = lhsT.shape[0]
    
    # Allocate output buffer in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray((M, N), dtype=lhsT.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    
    # Allocate SBUF for stationary and moving operands
    sbuf_stationary = nl.ndarray((K, M), dtype=lhsT.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    sbuf_moving = nl.ndarray((K, N), dtype=rhs.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    
    # Copy lhsT to sbuf_stationary
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf_stationary, src=lhsT)
    
    # Copy rhs to sbuf_moving
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf_moving, src=rhs)
    
    # Allocate PSUM buffer for matmul result
    psum = nl.ndarray((M, N), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.psum)
    
    # Perform NC matmul
    nisa.nc_matmul(dst=psum, stationary=sbuf_stationary, moving=sbuf_moving)
    
    # Copy result from PSUM to SBUF
    sbuf_out = nl.ndarray((M, N), dtype=lhsT.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.tensor_copy(dst=sbuf_out, src=psum)
    
    # Copy result from SBUF to shared HBM
